decision_rules_status: Fixed before new screening results; execution manifest still required
purpose: Resource-allocation screen for larger experiments; not significance, novelty, or journal qualification
execution_prerequisites: Classical algorithms integrated and checked against their definitions
All algorithms use the common dynamic decoder, four-vector feasibility, guarded evaluation and result archive
Fixed-FE and time checkpoints captured in one run without future leakage
Screening report uses the new practical-win rule, not old strict-positive win counts or rounded displayed percentages
Execution manifest with exact source, legal operators, parameters, initialization, seeds and inputs frozen before new performance results

clock_and_budget.calibration_completion_rule: Canonical configuration first; extra configurations in complete balanced rounds for all4 external methods; do not choose from partially completed rounds
clock_and_budget.fe_role: Diagnostic only; report unreachable checkpoints as censored, never impute or change the threshold
campaign_cap_excludes: First-time classical implementation and engineering acceptance

metrics.normalization_scale: Reuse exact128 independent-parent maxima in the completed step45 protocol for these same six inputs; freeze copied numeric arrays in the new execution manifest
metrics.igdplus_reference: Per instance nondominated union of all9 variants and all5 seeds final deadline-valid archives, fixed rule before runs; empirical reference only
metrics.practical_instance_win: HV effect >=1 percent and positive paired-seed HV difference in >=3/5 seeds
metrics.practical_instance_loss: HV effect <=-1 percent and negative paired-seed HV difference in >=3/5 seeds
metrics.degenerate_ratio_rule: Comparator meanHV <=1e-12 makes relative-HV gate unresolved; do not add an arbitrary denominator or call the candidate successful

strongest_external_rule.scope: One actual external algorithm for the whole screen, never an instance-wise oracle
strongest_external_rule.score: Mean over6 instances of (external meanHV / BASELINE meanHV) atT, primary reference
strongest_external_rule.selection: Largest score; tie within1e-12 resolved by larger median ratio, then label order
strongest_external_rule.scope_limit: Selected on development screen outputs; freeze its identity before followup; full external matrix still reported

red_any_sufficient_after_validity.scope: Pause scaling this frozen configuration; not a verdict on four-subswarm research

yellow: Valid and complete, neither red nor all green conditions met; at most one bounded followup, otherwise pause scaling

followup.priority: SHARE if yellow; otherwise VALUE_SHARE only ifSHARE green and VALUE_SHARE yellow
followup.eligible_if: No red condition or validity defect; initial matched-parent and TAIL green conditions already met; then either median FE15000 HV gain vs locked strongest external >=2percent with >=4 complete instance pairs (all5 seeds on both sides reached15000), or median_i(g_i(T)-g_i(0.5T)) >=2 percentagepoints
followup.analysis: New3 seeds at2T only; do not mix their terminal results with first5 atT
followup.igdplus_reference: Reuse the frozen empirical reference from the completed initial270 runs; never use it for search guidance
followup.positive_followup_scope: Limited scaling warranted; late-time superiority over all classical algorithms remains untested

old_step45_results_role: Development context and cost/reference design only; never retroactively classified with this standard or mixed with the new timed screen
statistical_scope: 6 development instances with5 repeats; effect sizes and uncertainty only; no claim of significance, unseen-instance generalization, or ESWA qualification
